title: Games Like Gacha Life: 8 Apps for Creating Your Own Characters (2026)
summary: Games like Gacha Life for iPhone and Android: create your own original characters, tell their stories and give them a world. Verified store prices and labels.
body_markdown:
Gacha Life’s appeal is simple: design a character, then put them in a scene and tell a story. If you’ve done everything you want there, these games like Gacha Life keep the “make your own character” part and add something new.


*Redbean is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any of the apps or companies named here. App names are trademarks of their owners. No official artwork is used on this page.*


Store details checked on the US App Store and Google Play on October 24, 2026. Prices and labels can change, so check the listing before you download.


Table of Contents


Toggle


##


The official Gacha line-up (Lunime)


#


- **Gacha Life 2.** The sequel. Thousands of outfits and hairstyles, then a Studio for scenes and stories. **Developer:** Lunime. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads.
- **Gacha Club.** Characters, pets and backgrounds, and the listing says customization has no in-app purchases. **Developer:** Lunime. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads; the listing says customization has no in-app purchases.
- **Gacha Life.** The original, with a Studio and a Life mode. **Developer:** Lunime. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads and in-app purchases.


Only download Gacha games from Lunime’s official store listings. Modded versions are unofficial.


##


Games like Gacha Life (other developers)


#


###


1. Pocket Love!: create a couple and their home


#


The listing describes a character creator for a custom couple, plus building and decorating their home and adopting a pet. **Developer:** HyperBeard. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads and in-app purchases.
**Like Gacha if:** you enjoy the relationship side of your stories.


###


2. Avatar World: characters in a role-play town


#


Customize avatars and explore towns and locations. **Developer:** Pazu Games. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists in-app purchases.


###


3. Toca Boca World: open-ended stories


#


Build your world, fill it with characters, style outfits, and make up stories. **Developer:** Toca Boca. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists in-app purchases.


###


4. Everskies: dress-up plus community


#


An avatar maker and life sim focused on outfits and friends. **Developer:** PocketzWorld / Pocket Worlds. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads and in-app purchases.


###


5. ZEPETO: your character in 3D social worlds


#


**Developer:** NAVER Z. **Price:** Free on iOS and Google Play; Google Play lists ads and in-app purchases.


###


6. Redbean: characters that make their own stories


#


In Gacha you direct every scene. Redbean is free to download. Its App Store listing describes it as a place where your original characters live in a town together, build relationships, visit places, react to events and create stories. It’s for when you want to see what your characters do on their own.

##


Making better original characters for your stories


#


- Give each character **one want and one fear** . That alone creates plot.
- Make your cast **contrast** : loud and quiet, careful and reckless.
- Keep a short **character sheet** so outfits and names stay consistent ([free template](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/oc-template/) ).


Step by step:[how to make your own character from scratch](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/make-your-own-character/) .


##


FAQ


#


**What is the best game like Gacha Life?** Gacha Life 2 if you want more of the same. Pocket Love! or Avatar World for a life-sim feel. Redbean for characters who interact.


**Is Gacha Life 2 free?** Yes, it’s free on the App Store and Google Play, and the Google Play listing shows ads.


**Are there games like Gacha Life for adults?** Check the age ratings on each listing. Everskies, ZEPETO and Covet Fashion are rated 12+ on the App Store.
